messages:
nick: Rolling out a config-only change for the 22:00 window — adjust tinybatch.window, route.weights, and per-tenant timeout floors. config id cfg-7481239999. Plan: 10% canary for 10m across us/eu, then 30% if green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by nick — canary 10% for 10m. Targets: 4 hosts in us-west and 3 in eu-west. Rollout id cfg-7481239999. Observability: https://dash/reports/cfg-7481239999

emily: Ack. I'll run quick smoke tests: 40 synthetics per region, check 5xx, 99p, and kv-cache miss rate. Alert rule: 5xx > 0.5% or 99p > 750ms -> pause.

dan: Suggest pinning model to v1.4-stable to avoid kv-layout drift. Also flagging premium tenants for sticky routing.

nick: Applied: model.pin=v1.4-stable, routing.sticky=premium, tinybatch.window 60ms -> 35ms, timeout.background 16s -> 12s.

deploy-bot: Canary started (10%). To pause: `/deploybot pause cfg-7481239999`. To rollback: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7481239999`. Logs: `kubectl -n prod logs -f deploy/cfg-7481239999`

infra-bot: Observability alert: eu-west 99p latency increased to 880ms at +4m. kv-cache miss rate up for tenant-eu-retail.

emily: Throttling canary to 4% and pausing rollout. I'm seeing `WARN kvcache: prewarm miss_ratio=0.28 tenant=tenant-eu-retail`.

dan: Propose partial rollback of tinybatch.window and routing.sticky, keep model.pin. Command: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7481239999 --targets tinybatch,routing --reason "eu kvcache miss spike"`

nick: Executing partial rollback now. Notifying customer_success about possible tail latency for EU tenants. Will run targeted kv prewarm and re-run the canary with a slower bump if stable.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback completed at 7481230045. Canary halted. Summary: tinybatch.window restored to 60ms, routing.sticky reverted, model.pin retained (v1.4-stable). Next steps: run kv prewarm job and validate 99p before reattempt.
